Yes. I found several Toronto/GTA agencies that look aligned with a small, integrated monthly retainer rather than hiring separate Reel, ads, and web vendors.

Agency	Why it fits	Published pricing / scope
ZimaPeak Marketing Inc.	Small-business focused; combines social, Meta/Google Ads and website work.	Publishes monthly Meta Ads tiers; also has a case study combining a new website, ads and social.
Creative Scope - Web Design & Digital Marketing Agency	Toronto creative/digital shop covering content production + social + web + performance marketing.	Likely worth asking for a defined monthly capacity rather than a fixed deliverable package.
Creative Squad Inc	11–50-person Toronto agency with social, content, paid marketing and web development under one roof.	More agency-like, but the service mix is unusually close to what you're describing.
Little Dragon Media	Toronto small/mid-business specialist combining paid social, web/landing pages, SEO and ongoing marketing.	Particularly relevant if the website changes are conversion/lead-gen oriented.
Qode Media	North York agency covering Meta/Facebook, social/content, web development and marketing automation.	Broader shop, but capable of being a single point of contact.
Whissel Strategies - Toronto Marketing Agency	Explicitly targets small-to-mid-sized businesses and combines social, content, paid ads and web/e-commerce.	More comprehensive/full-service positioning.
One particularly interesting model

Syntara is a very small, founder-led Toronto agency—the site says its work is handled by two founders—and explicitly combines social, paid ads and websites. It uses monthly retainers, has no long-term lock-in, and describes a cadence of weekly iteration plus monthly reporting. 
Syntara

That sounds quite close to the operating model you're describing.

There's also Elyflort, which publishes unusually concrete small-business packages: its $1,800/month Growth & Ads Pack includes Meta/Google/TikTok ads, website optimization, a content calendar and 5 optimized Reels, plus a photo session and additional recorded Reels. Website maintenance is separately listed at $200/month. 
Elyflort

What I'd ask for

Rather than asking “Do you do Reels, ads and websites?”, I'd ask for a monthly capacity retainer, e.g.:

$2,000–$3,000/month, excluding ad spend, with a defined amount of Reel production, Meta Ads management and website/dev time, and the ability to shift the mix month-to-month.

For example:

4–6 Reels/month

Meta Ads setup + ongoing optimization

$X/month of website/dev hours or a defined number of small changes

monthly reporting

one strategy call

one point of contact

no long-term contract

unused web hours either expire or roll over for one month

ad spend paid directly to Meta

all accounts/assets remain yours

That “monthly capacity, not rigid checklist” structure is already being offered by some agencies; Get Reel Ads, for example, explicitly sells monthly capacity where priorities can shift between ads, content and social rather than requiring the same deliverables every month. 
getreelads.com

If you tell me roughly what you want to spend per month (e.g. $1.5k, $2.5k, $4k) and whether the Reels require on-site filming or can be made from footage you provide, I can narrow this to 3–5 Toronto agencies that look like the closest operational fit.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
